cards.title: Ownership precedes work
items: Roles: Session is the main-thread owner; Channel is Worker transport; Worker owns a fresh SDK realm; Native run executes inside that Worker; Output gate is a pure shape/citation-identity check.
Only a configured generation adapter may run after an accepted query, with no active work. Preflight owns the document epoch and query before asynchronous imports or option getters.
Each attempt uses a fresh Worker. Session and transport independently check the same identity and contiguous event sequence. Late output from cancelled A cannot overwrite retry B.

cards.title: What the native run actually does
items: Stages: adapter → assets → sdk → tokenizer → model → generate → reads → cleanup. Progress reports observed bytes or elapsed milliseconds; an unknown total stays unknown.
The exact chat template, complete prompt tokens and reserved output budget are checked before model construction. WebGPU/q4 generation consumes only verified same-origin assets.
The native core disposes input/result tensors and model, closes the cache, and destroys its owned GPU device before the successful receipt returns.

cards.title: A draft gate is not financial verification
items: The session preserves the native invocation receipt separately from output inspection. EOS, complete JSON, schema and citation identity must pass before a draft is released.

The atomic terminal state is unverified-financial-draft or financial-output-refused. Claim support, factual correctness and evidence sufficiency remain unestablished; model abstention also remains unverified.

cards.title: Failure has a bounded terminal outcome
items: READY has at most 10 seconds; native work has at most 300 seconds. Receiving progress does not renew the hard work deadline.
Abort or timeout revokes the channel before listener removal and Worker termination. The session revokes output ownership before aborting or notifying subscribers.

cards.title: Local source audit and delivery scope
items: Inspected committed code at 10f962e4097f925eec87d4f783f4fb19ad0e922b. Source identities and SHA-256 values are preserved in .archify/sequence-owned-generation-20261011-090101/repository-evidence.json.
The staged repository has no origin remote. This is an inspected-code contract illustration, not Archify repository-provenance validation or evidence of a live model run.
Archify artifact delivery and strict provenance checks are separate from browser review. Its external Chrome browser gate is intentionally skipped under the Codex IAB-only requirement.

Readable rendering uses a task-local Archify 3.0.1 sequence adaptation: 16px message and role labels, 14px phase captions, with matching measured label boxes. Stock schema, SVG checker and artifact provenance are retained; policy and renderer hashes are in readable-renderer-policy.json.
